import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot for Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                                hue='Gender', size='Daily Steps', sizes=(20, 200), 
                                alpha=0.6, palette='deep')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender and Daily Steps', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10 scale)', fontsize=12)

# Add legend
plt.legend(title='Gender', loc='upper left')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot for Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                                hue='Gender', size='Daily Steps', sizes=(20, 200), 
                                alpha=0.6, palette='deep')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender and Daily Steps', fontsize=16)

plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10 scale)', fontsize=12)

# Add legend
